Photorealistic close-up of a curved LED dot-matrix media facade on the crown of a skyscraper at night. Thousands of tiny square pixels glowing teal-cyan and warm white inside a dark metal grille, black gaps between pixels, gentle vertical panel seams, restrained bloom and fine moiré. Abstract pixel pattern only. Shot with a telephoto lens, sharp, high detail, natural night exposure. No letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.
